import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD1 = 998244353L;
    static final long MOD2 = 1000000007L;
    static long answer;
    static long total;
    static long count1;
    static List<Long>[] values = new ArrayList[7];
    static long[] totalSum = new long[7];
    static long[] powers = {1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000, 100000, 1000000};
    static long count2;

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
            values[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static void generateValues(int level, long currentNumber) {
        if (level == 7) return;
        long val = (total - currentNumber + MOD1) % MOD1;
        values[level].add(val);
        totalSum[level] += val;
        total++;
        for (int digit = 0; digit <= 9; digit++) {
            generateValues(level + 1, currentNumber * 10 + digit);
        }
    }

    static boolean isInRange(long x) {
        return x * 1000000 + 999999 <= total && x * 10000000 > total;
    }

    static void explore(int level, long number) {
        if (number > total) return;
        if (isInRange(number)) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
                long offset = ((count2 + 1 - (number * powers[i]) % MOD1) + MOD1) % MOD1;
                int pos = lowerBound(values[i], MOD1 - offset);
                long size = values[i].size();
                long sumVal = totalSum[i];
                answer = (answer + (sumVal + offset * size - MOD1 * (size - pos))) % MOD2;
            }
            count2 += count1;
        } else {
            ++count2;
            answer = (answer + ((count2 - number) % MOD1 + MOD1) % MOD1) % MOD2;
            for (int digit = (level == 0 ? 1 : 0); digit <= 9; digit++) {
                explore(level + 1, number * 10 + digit);
            }
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Long> list, long key) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= key) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        total = Long.parseLong(br.readLine().trim());
        generateValues(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(values[i]);
        }
        count2 = -1;
        answer = 0;
        explore(0, 0);
        System.out.println(answer);
    }
}
